name: Breneland (Breneland-Next game + character builder test)
what: Breneland-Next (Breneland 2.0) is Andrew's multiplayer browser town game built in Three.js and live at breneland.fly.dev. Players make an avatar and hang out in a cartoon small town: dogs Dax, Nala and Molly, scripted townsfolk, fishing, swimming, a water tower climb, a maze under the Lovecraft house, table games, D&D night with Claude as the DM, shops and a clothing store. Work runs as numbered waves and fix rounds, each deployed as a Fly version (now around v319). The character builder test build (Brenelandtest repo) is a modular creator being developed separately before anything moves into the main game.
where: Code: the Breneland-Next repo. The one working copy is on Andrew's PC F: drive, and Google Drive is a backup (cleanup v154)
Live: breneland.fly.dev on Fly.io, persistent data volume at /data (snapshot before each deploy)
Docs in the repo: docs/briefs/*.md (one brief per job), docs/refs/<job>/, docs/CONTRACTS.md, LIGHTS.md, BLUEPRINT.md
On Drive: breneland2-progress.md (wave log), breneland2-plan.md, breneland2-answers.md (Andrew's answers, which override the plan)
Deploy: flyctl deploy from the PM session once tests pass. --depot=false was needed when Fly's registry refused pushes (v267)
Cloud sessions deliver branches that the PM session merges and ships
Character builder test: repo brenemanandrew/Brenelandtest (site/ and pipeline/); Fly deploy of the test site has failed twice at flyctl deploy (likely missing FLY_API_TOKEN or app-name mismatch)
stack: Three.js in the browser, custom toon and ink-outline renderer (toon.js, camera-fade.js, occlusion.js)
Node server (server.js, lib/*.js) holding the shared simulations: dogs at 20 Hz, maze ghoul, fires, table games, clock
Docker node:20-bookworm-slim plus python3 on Fly.io, 1 GB memory
Blender set pieces exported to public/models/*.json plus webp atlases; code-built versions kept as fallbacks
MPFB Blender characters with baked clips (BakedCharacter) for mall staff and the DM
Meshy props from the World Refresh (Meshy dogs now off)
Player bodies: the toy 'peak' body (PeakHuman, peak-body.js, peak-wear.js) since v310
D&D DM: Claude claude-opus-5-5 at low effort, server-rolled dice, 1.5M-token cap per night
DM voice: Andrew's fine-tuned Piper voice in a Python worker (lib/dm-voice-worker.py); browser voice fallback
Townsfolk brain: PC model MN-Violet-Lotus-12B via tools/npc-brain-bridge.mjs (NPC_BRAIN_TOKEN), text replies only
Music and SFX generated in Web Audio from CC0/CC-BY instruments

Builder: Three.js r181 from CDN, one file poser/index.html, data as base64 GLB in small JS files; two rigs (plus female, male) on the same 66-bone Mixamo skeleton with morph targets; pipeline in Blender Python (bpy) and puppeteer checks
